entities.name: Gebre Krestos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gebre Krestos was Emperor of Ethiopia from 24 March 1832 to his death on 8 June 1832. He was the son of Gebre Mesay, allegedly a descendant of a younger son of Emperor Fasilides.
